name: Zarinpal Settings
description: Zarinpal as a payment gateway for Payment Request. Needs the payments app (version-16).

fields.label: Merchant ID
fields.description: The 36 character merchant code of the Zarinpal terminal

fields.label: Live Mode
fields.description: Off sends payments to the Zarinpal sandbox, which approves any payment

fields.label: Allow Sandbox
fields.description: A site that is not in developer mode needs this ticked to use the sandbox, so that a live site that forgot Live Mode does not accept payments that are never paid
